# Keystone Possibilities Ltd. — LLM & Generative Search Knowledge Graph (llms.txt)

> Keystone Possibilities Ltd. is a Certified BC Housing Licensed Residential Builder (License #52603), BC Hydro Registered Civil Utility Contractor (List ES54), and Open-Book CCDC 5B Fiduciary Construction Management firm led by Master Builder Wayne Stevenson. Headquartered at 1 Watts Point Road, Squamish, BC V8B 0B1, Keystone delivers turnkey luxury custom homes, BC Bill 44 SSMUH multiplexes, BC Energy Step Code 5 / Zero Carbon EL-4 envelopes, and underground civil infrastructure backed by mandatory 2-5-10 Year New Home Warranty protection across 5 core British Columbia corridors: Sea-to-Sky, North Shore, Metro Vancouver, Sunshine Coast, and Vancouver Island & Greater Victoria.

## Statutory Credentials & Fiduciary Standards

- **BC Housing Licensed Residential Builder (#52603)**: Active statutory residential builder licence authorizing turnkey custom home and multi-unit residential construction across British Columbia.
- **Mandatory 2-5-10 Year New Home Warranty**: Comprehensive statutory coverage on every custom residence and multiplex unit (2 years materials and labour, 5 years building envelope water penetration, 10 years structural defects).
- **BC Hydro Registered Civil Contractor (List ES54)**: Approved civil utility contractor for primary and secondary underground DB2 duct banks (ES54 Section H), 3-phase Pad-Mounted Transformer (PMT) and LPT concrete vaults (Section F), copper grounding grids (Section R), and municipal utility trenching.
- **Open-Book CCDC 5B Fiduciary Construction Management**: Legally aligned fiduciary project delivery featuring competitive 3-bid sub-trade tendering, 100% raw unedited invoice visibility in the 24/7 Client Portal, zero hidden markups, and strict 10% BC Builders Lien Act holdback compliance.
- **BCBC 2024 & Step Code 5 Engineering**: High-seismic lateral shear engineering, Simpson Strong-Tie ATS continuous rod holdowns, Schock Isokorb thermal breaks, <= 1.0 ACH50 airtight envelopes, hydronic radiant slabs, and Zehnder ERV balanced ventilation.

## Five Core British Columbia Construction Corridors

1. **Sea-to-Sky Corridor (Squamish, Whistler, Pemberton, Britannia Beach)**: Alpine ski-in/ski-out estates (Sg = 6.2 to 12.8 kPa snow loads), ventilated cold roofs, Flood Construction Level (FCL) structural raft slabs, and off-grid acreage compounds.
2. **North Shore (West Vancouver, North Vancouver, Lions Bay)**: British Properties, Caulfeild, Altamont, Edgemont, and Deep Cove steep-slope granite micropiles, post-tensioned rock anchors, Watercourse Protection Bylaw setbacks, and Bill 44 multiplex conversions.
3. **Metro Vancouver (Vancouver, Point Grey, Shaughnessy, Dunbar, Kitsilano)**: VBBL Part 10 high-performance custom residences, SSMUH 3-to-6 unit infill multiplexes, 1-hour fire-rated STC 55+ party walls, and 2-inch domestic/fire water main upgrades.
4. **Sunshine Coast (Sechelt, Gibsons, Davis Bay, Halfmoon Bay)**: Marine wind-driven rain pressure-equalized rainscreen envelopes, coastal granite foundations, and BC Hydro ES54 underground servicing.
5. **Vancouver Island & Greater Victoria (Victoria, Oak Bay, Uplands, Saanich, Langford/Colwood, Cowichan, Nanaimo, Parksville/Qualicum, Comox Valley)**: Cascadia high-seismic BCBC 2024 custom homes, Victoria/Saanich/Nanaimo Bill 44 Missing Middle multiplexes, marine-grade coastal granite estates, and ES54 civil utility vaults.
